steps: Observe deterministic status from current relation/context hashes and supplied review history; inspect machine-readable selections and reasons; verify immutable inputs, detached outputs and no write attempts.

Inspect typed SRV025/SRV026/SRV027 findings, exact stored pointers and failure policy; verify structural and newest-current rejection precedence, lifecycle/audit exclusions, semantic changes and retained read-only boundaries.

oracle.requirement_contract: Eine strukturell gültige Relation MUSS ohne jedes frühere Review `unreviewed` und bei früherem, aber nicht mehr passendem Review `suspect` gemäß Anhang J.3 sein.
oracle.scope: A structurally valid relation without history is unreviewed; retained but nonmatching history yields suspect. Relation identity isolates histories; a newer nonmatching record cannot override an older matching review. R: typed diagnostics retain protected error severity and distinguish review_outcome from structural invalid; supplied-snapshot query preserves exact source pointers and original severity under strict/fail-on policies. Additional precedence, lifecycle/audit and input-ambiguity regressions retain all W expectations.
